prompt.en: Which province was the first to grant voting rights to women, in 1916?
prompt.fr: Quelle province a été la première à accorder le droit de vote aux femmes, en 1916?

explanation.en: In 1916 Manitoba became the first province to grant voting rights to women. Quebec was the last, in 1940.
explanation.fr: En 1916, le Manitoba est devenu la première province à accorder le droit de vote aux femmes. Le Québec a été le dernier, en 1940.

source.quote: In 1916, Manitoba became the first province to grant voting rights to women.
